items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Austin Ajiake is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Ravens.

items.title: Austin Ajiake (hamstring) listed questionable Sunday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) is officially questionable for Sunday's game against the Los Angeles Chargers.
items.impact: The rookie is officially being listed as questionable to play in Sunday's season opener. There have been a lot of optimistic reports surrounding his availability, so it looks more likely than not that he will suit up against the Chargers, although that decision won't be made until closer to game time. If he is ruled out, Tyler Allgeier will be primed for a massive workload in Week 1 in Love's absence.
items.title: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) officially questionable for Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Ashton Jeanty is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Dolphins.
items.impact: Jeanty practiced in full all week. He should be good to go in his lead role to open the season.
items.title: Ashton Jeanty (ankle) off injury report Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Seydou Traore is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Raiders.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Will Kacmarek is off the injury report for Sunday's game against Raiders.
items.impact: Kacmarek is good to go as had been reported.
items.title: Will Kacmarek (calf) off injury report Sunday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Jakobi Meyers (thumb) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Cleveland Browns.
items.impact: As expected, Meyers carries no injury designation ahead of Sunday's season opener and will be available to play against the Browns. His presence is further competition for Parker Washington and Brian Thomas Jr. in a crowded Jacksonville WR room.
items.title: Jakobi Meyers (thumb) good to go for Sunday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: LeQuint Allen Jr. (hip) is officially questionable for Sunday's game against the Cleveland Browns.
items.impact: Allen is uncertain to play on Sunday. He's still dealing with a hip injury of some kind, but he was able to take part in multiple practices this week, so he will have a real shot at suiting up against the Browns. Look for Chris Rodriguez Jr. to see more work if Allen is ruled out for the season opener.
items.title: LeQuint Allen Jr. (hip) officially questionable for Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Devontez Walker is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Colts.
items.impact: Walker was limited in practice all week. He'll hold a depth role if he is cleared.
items.title: Devontez Walker (groin) listed questionable Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Nnamdi Madubuike has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Colts.
items.impact: Madubuike had his career threatened, but he was cleared this offseason to return. He'll figure to still be eased back by Baltimore.
items.title: Nnamdi Madubuike (neck) ruled out Sunday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Keaton Mitchell (hamstring) is off of the injury report for Sunday's game against the Arizona Cardinals.
items.impact: Mitchell has been dealing with a nagging hamstring injury for a while, but it appears he is finally over it, as he has received full clearance to suit up and play for the Chargers in their season opener. He will remain relegated to a depth role behind Omarion Hampton for the foreseeable future, however.
items.title: Keaton Mitchell (hamstring) off injury report for Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Zay Flowers is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Colts.
items.impact: Flowers missed some practice time in the past couple of weeks with a hamstring injury. He'll be a full-go heading into the season off a new contract.
items.title: Zay Flowers (hamstring) off injury report Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Calais Campbell is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Colts.
items.impact: Campbell will be a full-go for Sunday's season opener.
items.title: Calais Campbell (rest) off injury report Sunday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Brenen Thompson (hip) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Arizona Cardinals.
items.impact: Thompson has been cleared to play for Sunday's game, meaning that his hip injury isn't a very serious issue at this point. He isn't expected to be fantasy relevant for the foreseeable future, however.
items.title: Brenen Thompson (hip) good to go for Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Teddye Buchanan has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Colts.
items.impact: Buchanan was limited in practice all week. It won't be enough for him to be cleared for the season opener.
items.title: Teddye Buchanan (knee) ruled out Sunday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Jonathan Greenard (pec) won't play in Sunday's game against the Washington Commanders.
items.impact: The veteran is going to be sidelined on Sunday. He's still recovering from an injury to his pec right now, and the team wants to give him all the time that he needs to rest and make a full recovery before playing. His absence will leave Philadelphia's defensive front slightly weaker than usual against the Commanders.
items.title: Jonathan Greenard (pec) won't play Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Malik Nabers is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Cowboys.
items.impact: The reports all week have suggested Nabers is expected to be good to go for Sunday's season opener. He should be on the favorable side of questionable going into the weekend.
items.title: Malik Nabers (knee) officially questionable Sunday
